reason: Fifteen hundred a month is less than I lose in one argument over a frame, and the screen is already on the wall playing cricket nobody is watching. I'll take the free month because the league table is the part I can't do on a whiteboard - people coming back on a Tuesday to defend a place is my slow night fixed.
objection: My whole crowd lives in my WhatsApp group. If I have to chase them to scan a code and they half do it, I'm running the night twice - once on the app and once on my phone like always - and then I'm paying for extra work.
would_change_my_mind: If it posted the bracket, the results and the league table straight into my WhatsApp group so I never have to retype anything, I'd stop thinking about the price at all.
